label: github: open commit
command: repo=$(git remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#^(https?://|ssh://git@|git@)github\.com[:/]##; s#\.git$##') && sha=$(git blame -L $ZED_ROW,$ZED_ROW --porcelain $ZED_FILE | head -1 | awk '{print $1}') && gh browse --repo "$repo" "$sha"

label: github: open PR
command: repo=$(git remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#^(https?://|ssh://git@|git@)github\.com[:/]##; s#\.git$##') && sha=$(git blame -L $ZED_ROW,$ZED_ROW --porcelain $ZED_FILE | head -1 | awk '{print $1}') && url=$(gh api "repos/$repo/commits/$sha/pulls" --jq '.[0].html_url') && if [ -n "$url" ]; then xdg-open "$url"; else echo "No pull request found for commit $sha" >&2; exit 1; fi

label: github: open repo
command: repo=$(git remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#^(https?://|ssh://git@|git@)github\.com[:/]##; s#\.git$##') && gh browse --repo "$repo"
